The command line

Everything the terminal does with books is open to scripts as well. Every command takes --dir (the workspace) and, where the workspace holds several sets of books, --books; spezado help <command> shows its options.

Command  
init creates a workspace for this device
books lists the books of the workspace
set-up sets up books for a person or an organisation
book records a booking from lines
reverse reverses a booking by the event that recorded it
journal, balance the journal, the balance of every account
report a report for a period, or – without one – the reports that apply
check what needs review
close closes an owner’s books up to a date
filing lists the filings; prepare, submit [--test], refresh (Filings)
adapter shows or sets the adapter that submits filings in a country, the token from SPEZADO_ADAPTER_TOKEN
export, import the events of the books as JSON Lines, out and in
sync synchronises books with other devices and people: start, invite --rights, join, recover, devices, remove (Synchronisation)
relay runs a relay
tui, serve the terminal; the web app and API – serve --listen 0.0.0.0:8443 for other devices, over TLS (The web app)
openapi the description of the API

A freelancer’s quarter 

spezado init
spezado set-up --name "Ada" --from 2026-01-01 --accounting de-cash-basis \
  --vat de-regular --vat-basis cash --vat-period quarter --chart de-skr03 --region DE-BE
spezado book --date 2026-02-10 --text "Invoice 1" 1200=1190 8400=-1000@de-out-19 1776=-190@de-out-19
spezado book --date 2026-02-12 --text "Paper" 4930=10@de-in-19 1576=1.90@de-in-19 1200=-11.90
spezado journal
spezado report de-ustva --from 2026-01-01 --to 2026-03-31
spezado check

A line of book is an account – its number in the books’ chart, or its UUID –, =, the amount with a decimal point, positive for debit and negative for credit, and optionally @ and a tax code; the lines must balance.

set-up without --legal-form sets up a person’s books; with one (de-gmbh, de-ev, …) an organisation’s. --accounting is de-cash-basis or de-double-entry, --vat de-regular or de-small-business, --chart de-skr03 or de-skr04; --vat-extended and --region (DE-BY, DE-NW, …) move the deadlines.

The reports for German books are de-ustva (advance VAT return) and de-euer (Anlage EÜR) on a cash basis, and the balance sheet and profit and loss account after the HGB with double entry.
